claim: AAAI-26 requires authors to state the number of algorithm runs used to compute each reported result, with only a binary yes/no answer allowed (no partial credit).
stance_target: single-run point-estimate AUROC/ECE numbers are below the AAAI main-track bar
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist, appended to every submission
quoted_support: This paper states the number of algorithm runs used to compute each reported result. (yes/no)

claim: AAAI-26 requires experimental analysis to go beyond single-dimensional summaries (mean/median) to include measures of variation, confidence, or distributional information.
stance_target: bootstrap CIs / variance reporting are a formal requirement, not optional rigor
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist
quoted_support: Analysis of experiments goes beyond single-dimensional summaries of performance (e.g., average; median) to include measures of variation, confidence, or other distributional information. (yes/no)

claim: AAAI-26 requires that any claimed performance improvement or decrease be judged using an appropriate statistical significance test, explicitly naming Wilcoxon signed-rank as an accepted method.
stance_target: AAAI expects formal significance testing of AUROC/ECE deltas vs baselines
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist
quoted_support: The significance of any improvement or decrease in performance is judged using appropriate statistical tests (e.g., Wilcoxon signed-rank). (yes/partial/no)

claim: AAAI-26 requires disclosure of computing infrastructure (GPU/CPU models, memory, OS, library versions) and the method used for setting random seeds sufficient to allow replication.
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist
quoted_support: This paper specifies the computing infrastructure used for running experiments (hardware and software), including GPU/CPU models; amount of memory; operating system; names and versions of relevant software libraries and frameworks. (yes/partial/no)

claim: AAAI-26 requires authors to state the number and range of hyperparameter values tried during development, along with the selection criterion for the final setting.
stance_target: hyperparameter search disclosure as a reproducibility norm
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist
quoted_support: This paper states the number and range of values tried per (hyper-) parameter during development of the paper, along with the criterion used for selecting the final parameter setting. (yes/partial/no/NA)

claim: AAAI-26 requires code and novel datasets to be made publicly available upon publication under a license permitting free research use.
stance_target: code/artifact release is a formal AAAI expectation, not optional
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track reproducibility checklist
quoted_support: All source code required for conducting and analyzing the experiments will be made publicly available upon publication of the paper with a license that allows free usage for research purposes. (yes/partial/no)
